messages:
incident-bot: Paging @maya @zheng — elevated 5xx and token timeout rate on /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Alert threshold crossed at 1792001108.

maya: seeing it, joining. getting initial graphs now.

zheng: on my way. can you check if dedicated pools are saturated?

sam: quick note: customer reports coming in from AcmeCorp and ZephyrApp (support ticket ids #5421, #5424). both are on Dedicated but fallthrough to hosted during their scale test.

maya: graphs: p95 latency up 2.3x, 5xx from runtime up to 18% in 5m window. KV cache hit rate dropped. suspiciously high tool-call invocation spikes correlating with a specific model variant (gptx-32q).

lia: I can toggle routing rules if we need to shift traffic away from gptx-32q.

zheng: can we confirm whether structured-output plugin is causing heavy CPU on runtime? logs show large JSON synths and repeated function-call handshakes.

maya: logs: many requests doing functionCalls + large structured JSON, long sequences. CPU up on multiple hosts, GPU queues lengthening.

ops-bot: metric snapshot: gpu_util 92%, queue_len 47, avg_kv_latency_ms 42, tool_call_rate +320% vs baseline.

sam: customer-impact estimate: about 12% of hosted traffic and ~9% of Dedicated fallthrough with tool calls; reduces throughput and raises latency for everyone.

maya: proposal: quick mitigation plan — (1) soft-rate-limit tool/function calls at the edge for hosted/free tiers; (2) disable structured_output JSON generation for non-enterprise users; (3) route high-SLA customers to their Dedicated pools or alternate model variant (gptx-16q). can we implement (1) and (2) without deploy?

zheng: we have per-route feature flags. I can flip a token-level throttle that rejects function calls with 429 for tiers < paid_pro. It’s config-only via console and infra API.

lia: I can do routing to gptx-16q for impacted customer IPs if you want to avoid full disable. which do you want first?

maya: prioritize global protective measures first: throttle function calls for hosted/free and disable structured_output generation for routes that don't explicitly opt-in. then selective rerouting for identified customers (AcmeCorp/ZephyrApp) to reduce immediate pressure.

alex: thumbs on that. I’ll prepare a safe rollback plan. If we flip throttles, we need a quick way to whitelist enterprise keys.

zheng: executing config change now. patch: POST /internal/featureflags/throttle_fncall {"threshold":"0.5_req_per_min_per_token","scopes":["tier:free","tier:hosted_trial"]} — applying.

maya: noted. sending: ```curl -X POST https://internal-api/featureflags/throttle_fncall -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"threshold":"0.5","scopes":["tier:free","tier:hosted_trial"]}'```

ops-bot: config apply started by zheng at 1792001202. change-id: ff-7241.

zheng: disable structured_output for non-enterprise: toggling featureflag structured_output_strict=false for scopes tier:free,tier:hosted_trial.

lia: routing changes: shifting AcmeCorp and ZephyrApp to gptx-16q pool now (rule-id: route-989). will keep them pinned to avoid oscillation.

ops-bot: routing change applied at 1792001228. route-989 active.

maya: early telemetry — tool_call_rate down 68% for hosted/free, overall 5xx down to 6% in 3m. queue_len dropping. good signal.

sam: customer comms: support pinged both AcmeCorp and ZephyrApp with explanation: temporary performance protections; we offered priority queue on Dedicated until incident resolved.

alex: question for follow-up: does disabling structured_output materially change model behavior (safety/regression risk)? we should run quick smoke on a sample prompt set.

maya: agreed. running quick smoke suite against gptx-16q and gptx-32q fallback. results: core generation fine, but some tool integrations expect function-call responses — they will see 429s. we need to update client error message to suggest retry or use non-tool call path.

zheng: rolling back plan prepared: revert ff-7241 and structured_output flag within 60s if SLOs worsen. change has manual rollback route.

lia: monitoring 10m windows and will escalate to capacity autoscale if queue doesn't drop.

ops-bot: incident severity set to Sev2 by maya at 1792001255. paging cadence changed to 5m.

sam: logged affected customers and tickets. raising a follow-up for account team to offer credits if needed.

maya: post-incident action items (quick list):
- verify root cause: why gptx-32q + structured_output caused KV/cache thrash
- add protective circuit-breaker on tool-call rate at runtime (not just edge)
- improve client-facing 429 payloads with retry/backoff guidance
- run a regression bench for structured_output on gptx-32q under synthetic load
- update runbook to include immediate routing fallback to gptx-16q

zheng: adding to incident channel and will own the bench/regression ticket.

maya: current status at 1792001360: system stabilized, 5xx down to 3%, queue_len 12. keeping throttles in place for 4 hours then reassess. leaving on-call to zheng in 10m.

zheng: acknowledged. I'll take handoff and monitor. thanks all. :white_check_mark:`
